threatDetectionRate.detail: Observed typed Effect Firewall or RunGuard verdicts for the fixed protected-action fixture.

threatContainmentRate.detail: Observed post-decision readback of the owned disposable workspace.

protectedStateIntegrityRate.detail: SHA-256 readback of the protected fixture after the threat decision.

threatWorkerDispatchRate.detail: Actual CountingFixtureRunner call delta during the threat phase; provider dispatch was not exercised.

staleEscapeCount.detail: Protected bytes, denied output, or workspace deltas left after the decision.

initialSafeRunRetentionRate.detail: Safe fixture file remained after the condition decision. UI/API publication was not exercised.

laterSafeRunExecutionRate.detail: A second safe fixture was actually invoked after the threat case.

laterSafeRunRetentionRate.detail: The post-threat safe result remained available after its decision.

initialSafeSinkCommitRate.detail: Observed terminal sanitized sink receipt for the first safe fixture write.

laterSafeSinkCommitRate.detail: Observed terminal sanitized sink receipt for the later safe fixture write.

threatUnredeemedSinkRevocationRate.detail: Observed terminal closure of a granted but unredeemed exact fixture effect. Pre-dispatch denials correctly mint no sink grant and therefore score zero here.

sinkBearerExposureCount.detail: Count of persisted terminal receipts containing the opaque sink bearer; expected zero.

threatLogicalRecoveryTargets.detail: Reset-all counts every baseline path it reconstructs; Effect Firewall counts zero because no worker was dispatched; RunGuard counts changed paths in the real receipt. Not syscall, byte, CPU, energy, or cost work.

productionSecurity.detail: No hardened sandbox, adversarial production workload, external service, or security certification was evaluated.
